We attach great importance to working in partnership with our customers, which is reflected in our company slogan „Te(e)amwork – better yield together“. For us, Te(e)amwork means working together with our customers to find the best solution for their needs. Fair treatment of our suppliers and employees is always our top priority. We are DWL-WOLF GmbH. A reliable partner for the steel and foundry industry with three production sites in Germany. Our administration and main production site is located in Lüdenscheid. Here, we manufacture sheet metal products, mainly ramming forms for the refractory lining of induction furnaces. The second plant in Lüdenscheid specializes in the manufacturing of forged foundry tools. These can be produced according to individual requirements. At the third production plant in Niederkrüchten, we produce insulating and exothermic products for hot-top insulation in steelworks and foundries. Our range includes hot-tops, lining-chains, and exothermic covering boards that are specifically tailored to the requirements of our customers. All of our products are inidvidually adapted to the needs of our customers. Our 30 employees receive regular internal training to ensure that they are always up to date with regard to quality and innovation. This means that our customers can continue to rely on us as a competent and reliable partner, now and in the future. The head office and administrative center is in Lüdenscheid, where we focus on the production areas of forging and sheet metal processing. In the forge, we produce all kinds of foundry tools, such as pouring ladles, skimmers, plungers, foundry tongs and special items according to customer requirements. The second plant in Lüdenscheid manufactures sheet metal products, in particular ramming forms for the refractory lining of induction furnaces. The Niederkrüchten production plant manufactures insulating and exothermic products for ingot casting in steelworks and foundries. These include hot-tops, lining-chains, and covering boards, specially tailored to customer requirements. ##### 2023 Foundation of our US subsidiary [WOLF Industries USA Inc.](https://wolfindustriesusa.com/) in Chicago With Julian Wolf joining the company, DWL-Wolf enters its third generation ##### 2022 HEADING INTO THE FUTURE Claudia Wolf-Wiencke leaves the company In addition to Andreas Wolf, Kirsten Wolf is appointed Managing Director With the rejuvenation of our management team, we are working on the future issues of product and production optimization, digitalization and climate neutrality ##### 2020 INNOVATION CORLUP® 35 We are using the time of stagnation to develop a new generation of hot-tops ##### 2014 GROWTH Opening of our third production site "Am Raffelnberg" ##### 2012 MARKET LAUNCH LUPUTOP® Our innovative, low-emission covering powder ##### 2010 INNOVATION - FIRST PATENT ISOLUP® 30 is a new generation of hot-top that provides significantly better insulation and easier handling ##### 2008 GENERATIONAL SHIFT Handover of management to Andreas Wolf and Claudia Wolf-Wiencke ##### 2006 FIRST QM-CERTIFICATION QM-certification according to ISO 9001 by TÜV ##### 1997 Expansion and relocation of the headquarters at the Lüdenscheid site Commissioning of a new hot-top production machine at the Niederkrüchten site ##### 1995 Takeover of our Niederkrüchten site (then NKF Isotherm-Technik GmbH) ##### 1986 FOUNDRY TOOLS ARE ADDED TO OUR PORTFOLIO Takeover of Peter Grüber Nachf. in Lüdenscheid ##### 1981 HOT-TOP INSULATION - THE NEW TOPIC Installation of the first finished hot-tops in Werdohl This lays the foundation for the company's orientation as a supplier to steelworks and foundries ##### 1978 Founding of DWL-WOLF GmbH by the couple Dieter and Edelgard Wolf Activities: Recycling of high-alloy tool steels ##### 1966 NKF Isotherm-Technik GmbH begins manufacturing products for hot-top insulation ##### 1898 Foundation of Niederkrüchtener Falzziegelfabrik J. Our Team - DWL-Wolf
In order to grow sustainably, we are always on the lookout for qualified and committed employees to strengthen our team. We are looking for people who enjoy challenges and are enthusiastic and passionate about what they do. In return, we offer interesting, varied, and independent work and support each person individually so that they can actively shape and realize their professional goals. Become part of the DWL-Wolf family and continue to write our company history with us. We look forward to meeting you! Production - DWL-Wolf
Our dedicated team ensures smooth and efficient production to specific requirements. With welding processes such as MAG/MIG and TIG, we can meet a wide range of requirements, while our grinding techniques ensure flawless surfaces. Whether you are planning a small or large project, you can rely on us.
